$comment: The port verb surface: nine REQUIRED verbs (research/10 §5.1 as amended by erratum) plus optional capabilities backends declare in backend.toml. Args are CLI flags on `seed task <verb>`; outputs are fields in the envelope (envelope.schema.json). Transition legality, classes, and effects come from transitions.json — this file only describes I/O shapes.

args.squad: string (optional capability ready_squad; shim-side filter otherwise)

output.tasks: [{task, title, priority, squad, created_at}] ordered by priority

ready.notes: No open blockers, unclaimed, claimant not in rejected_authors. Must be cheap; reads fetch first (staleness bounded and explicit).

release.notes: Worker release; operator reap uses the reap override in transitions.json, presenting an operator credential and no token.

args.no-pr: flag: human close via workflow_dispatch (D7 exemption; server-attributed)

args.token: required while the card holds a claim

args.ref: required (SHA, URL, path, or excerpt ref)
args.token: required while the card holds a claim

args.event: JSON object {ts, actor, verb, task, data}, required

event-append.notes: Every mutating verb self-appends to run-log.jsonl in the same state-ref commit (§7.2: one commit per verb, card mutation + event line atomically). This verb exists for out-of-band events; it is the audit substrate and required even when the backend has its own trail.

lease-renew.notes: Required capability of the filecards backend.
